Battlefield Nordmarka — Leopard 2A4NO

WSADDrive: throttle / reverse, steer (pivots on the spot). Plowed roads are faster than deep snowMouseClick to capture. Aim the sight; the turret and gun follow at their own pace — fire when the ring is greenLeft buttonFire the 120 mm gun (6 s to reload)Right button · CGunner sight (hold, or toggle with C) — wheel changes magnification123APFSDS (armour) · HEAT-MP (multi-purpose) · HE (soft targets, big blast)SpaceQHold Space for the machine gun: the coaxial MG3 by default; when you look higher than the gun can elevate (up to 70°) or put the crosshair on a drone, the commander's hatch MG3 fires instead — the answer to enemy drones. Q forces the hatch MG. Red arrows round the crosshair point to incoming FPV drones and Lancets (blinking: diving at you). Smoke breaks a Lancet's lock; trees and moving make you harder to find. An Orlan circling high tells the enemy where you are — shoot it down. Some T-72s carry a cope cage that blunts drone attacks from aboveGSmoke grenades — breaks the enemy's line of sight, and blinds thermal sights tooVThermal imager in the gunner sight and on the drone: off · white-hot · black-hot. Sees engines, tracks and fires through darkness, haze and dustXZLaunch a drone; Z picks the type. Mouse + WASD fly, Space/Shift up/down. FPV (5): fly into a vehicle, left button detonates. BOMB (2): hovers, the camera tilts straight down, left button drops one of 3 grenades on the marker (roof and engine deck are weak); land on the tank to rearm. RECON (2): climbs to 110 m, 6 min, unarmed; what its camera sees goes on the map; X with it up hands it to its autopilot (it circles and keeps watching until the battery is flat) and puts you back in the tank, X again takes it back. X again cuts the link (the drone is lost). The tank stands still and exposed meanwhileBArtillery: one fire mission per wave (restocked when the wave is cleared) — six 155 mm rounds land around the point about 25 s later. In the tank it goes where the sight is laid; from a drone, where its camera looks (the bomber: on the drop marker). Kills light vehicles and BMPs, wrecks houses, often knocks out a T-72. Within 150 m of your tank it is danger closeMinesEnemy engineers mine roads ahead (a faint grey patch in the snow, warm in the thermal sight) and rockets can scatter mines around you. Driving onto one blows a track: you are stuck for a few seconds (TRACK) and lose hull. Drones and a close look mark them with red flags; HE or a burst of MG fire sets them offTNMUTime of day · snowfall · sound · musicRHEscRestart · this help · menuGamepadLeft stick drive · right stick aim · R2 fire · L2 sight (hold; L3 locks it) · R1 MG · R3 force hatch MG · L1 smoke · □ ammo · △ thermal · hold ✕ launch drone · hold ○ artillery · D-pad ↑↓ magnification, ←→ drone type · Create map · Options menu (Vibration: off / light / full)Pad, droneLike a DJI controller (Mode 2): left stick height and turn · right stick fly · L1/L2 tilt the camera · R2 detonate / drop · hold ✕ back to the tank (recon: autopilot) · hold ○ artillery where the camera looks · △ thermal · D-pad ↑↓ view: FPV chase far / chase / goggles, bomber and recon outside / camera / 2× / 4× (the mouse wheel and pinch do the same)
Left thumbJoystick: push to drive, sideways to steerRight sideDrag to look around · pinch to zoomFIRE · AMMOFire the main gun · cycle APFSDS / HEAT-MP / HE (the ammo pill at the top shows what is loaded)MG · SMOKEHold for the machine gun (it switches to the hatch MG on its own when you drag the view up or onto a drone; red arrows round the crosshair point to incoming drones) · fire the smoke grenadesDRONE · TYPELaunch the drone named on the button; TYPE switches FPV / BOMB / RECON. Joystick flies, drag turns (and tilts the bomber camera), UP / DOWN change height, BOOM detonates the FPV, DROP releases a grenade, TANK cuts the link. Land the bomber or recon drone on the tank to get it backARTYOne artillery fire mission per wave: six 155 mm rounds land about 25 s later on the point the sight is laid on — or, from a drone, where its camera looks. Keep your tank 150 m clearMapTap the map for the large view (tap again to close). Enemies someone has seen — the crew, the sight, a drone or their own muzzle flash (red T-72, orange BMP-2; hollow = last known position)MinesGrey patches in the snow on roads ahead may be mines; red flags mark the ones found.
